title: American Vanguard Announces Third Quarter 2025 Earnings
summary: American Vanguard Announces Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Newport Beach, CA | November 5, 2025 American Vanguard (r) Company announced today that it will report financial results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2025, on Monday, November 10, 2025, before the market opens . The company will conduct an earnings conference call on November 10 at 9:00 am ET/ 6:00 am PT. Dak Kaye CEO and David T. Johnson CFO will participate in this event.
